name: cPanel
line: Install a web hosting control panel on your own server.

free.text: 15-day trial, up to 30 accounts; one per static public IP

cells.selfhost: Yes; install on a VPS or dedicated server

work.math: $29.99 a month for the Solo Cloud license, plus the server, domain, data sent out and backups.
The license and a server running for 730 hours are separate costs. The full server cost is unknown.
The license, server resources, PostgreSQL and outside backups each need their own pricing.
